title: SieveScript/set: onSuccessActivateScript with a nonexistent id deactivates the active script
description: sieve.rs:891-913, 953-958 deactivates before activating; target notFound is ignored. RFC 9661 §2.4: an invalid or nonexistent id "MUST be ignored, and the currently active SieveScript (if any) will remain as such". (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
